body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Toshiba showcased its convertible tablet PC 'Portege M750' at CES 2009. Featuring indoor/outdoor LED backlit displays, it is equipped with a built-in optical drive, a webcam and business card reader.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
